g.text: Pipeline: cnn_deser (first) -> cnn_window -> 8 x cnn_lane -> 8 x cnn_pool -> cnn_pack -> cnn_bus (last) -> DRAM. cnn_bus issues every DRAM command; cnn_ctrl times the datapath from iw_pre.
register (D flip-flops on clk rising edge)
name = net label (same name, same net)
